data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Coded Culinary

Home | Recipes | Baking

Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: -20 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, mix heavy cream and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet, brush with additional cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
  8. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack.

Tips

For best results, keep ingredients cold and avoid overmixing. Frozen blueberries can be used—do not thaw before adding.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Welcome to Coded Culinary's Blueberry Scones recipe page.

**Recipe Details:**
- Prep Time: 15 minutes
- Cook Time: -20 minutes
- Total Time: 35 minutes
- Servings: 8 scones

**Ingredients:**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Additional cream and coarse sugar for topping

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
8. Place wedges on baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
10. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

**Tips:**
- For best results, keep butter and cream cold.
- Frozen blueberries can be used; do not thaw before adding.
- Serve warm with clotted cream or lemon curd.

**Nutritional Information (per scone):**
- Calories: 320
- Fat: 18g
- Carbohydrates: -36g
- Protein: 5g

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Coded Culinary

Home | Recipes | Baking

Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: -20 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, mix heavy cream and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet, brush with additional cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
  8. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack.

Tips

For best results, keep ingredients cold and avoid overmixing. Frozen blueberries can be used—do not thaw before adding.

Here's the Blueberry Scones recipe from Coded Culinary:

### Blueberry Scones
**Prep time:** 15 minutes  
**Cook time:** 20 minutes  
**Difficulty:** Easy  

![Freshly baked blueberry scones](http://www.codedculinary.com/images/blueberry-scones.jpg)

**Ingredients:**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 cup heavy cream
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. Mix heavy cream and vanilla in a separate bowl, then add to dry ingredients. Stir until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on baking sheet, brush with additional cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
8. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack.

**Tip:**  
Keep ingredients cold and avoid overmixing. Frozen blueberries can be used—do not thaw before adding.
